text: In the formula ∀x (P(x) → Q(x, z)), which variables are free, and is it a sentence?
choices: x is free; it is a sentence
both x and z are bound; it is a sentence
z is free; it is not a sentence (a sentence has no free variables)
neither variable is free; it is a sentence
explanation: x is bound by ∀x, but z occurs free (no quantifier binds it), so the formula has a free variable and is therefore not a sentence. A sentence (closed formula) has no free variables, so the options calling it a sentence (1, 2, 4) are wrong because of the free z.
